title: Jacobi-Zariski sequence is exact on the left when the last map is a regular-sequence quotient
statement: Let $A\to B\xrightarrow{\ \varphi\ }C$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, $C$ an $A$-algebra through the composite. Assume there are integers $m,c\ge0$, elements $f_1,\dots,f_c$ of the polynomial ring $B[y_1,\dots,y_m]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] which form a regular sequence in $B[y_1,\dots,y_m]$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], and a surjective homomorphism of $B$-algebras $\beta:B[y_1,\dots,y_m]\to C$ whose kernel is the ideal $(f_1,\dots,f_c)$. For a ring map $R\to S$ let $\mathrm{NL}_{S/R}=\bigl(I_{S/R}/I_{S/R}^2\xrightarrow{\delta_{S/R}}\bigoplus_{s\in S}S\,\mathrm d[s]\bigr)$ be the naive cotangent complex of the canonical presentation $R[S]\to S$, $[s]\mapsto s$, with kernel $I_{S/R}$, and $H_1(L_{S/R})=\ker\delta_{S/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Let $H_1(\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}\otimes_BC)$ be the kernel of $\delta_{B/A}\otimes\mathrm{id}_C:I_{B/A}/I_{B/A}^2\otimes_BC\to\bigoplus_{b\in B}C\,\mathrm d[b]$, and let $\varphi_\sharp:A[B]\to A[C]$ be the $A$-algebra map $[b]\mapsto[\varphi(b)]$. Then the $C$-linear map $I_{B/A}/I_{B/A}^2\otimes_BC\to I_{C/A}/I_{C/A}^2$, $(g\bmod I_{B/A}^2)\otimes c\mapsto c\cdot(\varphi_\sharp(g)\bmod I_{C/A}^2)$, maps $H_1(\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}\otimes_BC)$ into $H_1(L_{C/A})$, and its restriction $u:H_1(\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}\otimes_BC)\to H_1(L_{C/A})$ is injective.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07D4 (lemma-transitive-lci-at-end, line 8459), its 'in particular' clause (the six-term sequence of Algebra Lemma 00S2 completed with a zero on the left), for B -> C presented by a regular sequence: a regular sequence is Koszul-regular (More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 062F, lemma-regular-koszul-regular, line 7265), so B -> C is a local complete intersection in the sense of More on Algebra, Definition Tag 07D0 (definition-local-complete-intersection, line 8338). Proof of 07D4 (lines 8494-8505) uses Lemma Tag 07CX (lemma-conormal-sequence-H1-regular-ideal, line 8235). Tags verified in literature/stacks-project/tags/tags.
